key_facts: The welder has a Cold Wire Feed Switch accessible from the interior
The unit includes a Feed Tensioner for wire tension adjustment
A Wire Feed Mechanism is located in the interior of the unit
The Wire Spool mounts on the left side of the interior
The Spool Knob is located on the lower left of the interior
A Wire Inlet Liner guides wire into the feed mechanism
An Idler Arm is present on the right side of the wire feed mechanism
A Feed Roller Knob is located on the lower right of the wire feed area
A Foot Pedal Socket is accessible at the bottom of the interior
A Wire Feed Control Socket is accessible at the bottom of the interior
Item number for this welder is 57812
